from: chapitres 0, 2 et 3 de la vidéo longue (la vente de 2014, la cession-bail, le loyer qui monte de 2 % par an, la clientèle en baisse ; coupé : histoire, Thai Union, crevettes, relance)
paragraphs: Everyone says endless shrimp killed Red Lobster. Its bankruptcy filing points somewhere else.
In {twenty fourteen|2014}, a private equity firm bought the chain for {two point one billion dollars|$2.1 billion}.
In the same deal, the buildings under about {five hundred|500} restaurants were sold for {one and a half billion|$1.5 billion}, and rented back.
That rent went up {two percent|2%} every year. Meanwhile, the chain lost about {thirty percent|30%} of its customers after {twenty nineteen|2019}.
By {twenty twenty-three|2023}, Red Lobster owed about {a hundred and ninety million dollars|$190.5 million} a year in leases. The shrimp was just the last wave. Full story on the channel.
